metadata.title: Cezar Pretto — Custom software | from paper to product
metadata.description: Cezar Pretto builds custom software for companies that want to take projects and products off the paper or solve problems with technology. Software engineer and Lead Software Engineer at Gupy.
metadata.keywords: Cezar Pretto, custom software, software development, software engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Tech Lead, React, Next.js, Node.js

hero.intro: You show up with the idea, the stalled project, or the system that no longer keeps up with the business. I understand the problem, design the solution and ship it working, with you following every step.
hero.meta: Cezar Pretto · software engineer · partner and Lead Software Engineer at Gupy
hero.caption: Illustrative example: a technical proposal becomes a system in production as you scroll.
